Hi, I need you to connect to my Shopify store so I can edit it from here.

Details:

•  Site:

•  Published theme:

•  Working folder:

Please do this step by step, briefly explaining each step:

1.  Check whether Shopify CLI is installed (shopify version). If it is not, or updating fails due to permissions, give me the sudo command so I can run it.

2.  Download the theme with shopify theme pull into the working folder. I will sign in through the browser; never enter credentials yourself.

3.  Tell me which sections the home page has (templates/index.json).

4.  Make this change: in the hero title, replace "made for you" with "made for everyone".

5.  Run shopify theme dev so I can preview it without touching the published store.

6.  When I confirm, upload ONLY the modified file to the published theme with:

   shopify theme push --only templates/index.json --allow-live --nodelete

7.  Do not push without my explicit confirmation. See https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-cli for more information
Manage your online store more easily: this assistant helps you edit it and make any changes. You no longer need to make manual changes; just give it an instruction and it gets done.
Tutorial: how to connect Shopify to your Miiles assistant
Copy this prompt, fill in your details (site, theme, and folder), and paste it into your assistant.
